hero: When I hit a wall, I climb it.
heroDesc01: With the persistence and focus honed through bouldering, I overcome walls blocked by code.
heroDesc02: I'm Minseob Shim, a developer who creates better user experiences through persistence and exploration.
typeText:
Hello!
I'm Minseob Shim, a frontend developer.

After graduating from high school and university in the U.S., I'm now based in Korea, building various web and mobile applications.
I primarily work with React, TypeScript, and React Native, with a strong focus on creating better user experiences.

Over the past year, I've taken part in more than 10 projects,
working in teams of various sizes and across different domains.
I'm well-adapted to fast feedback loops in Agile environments,
experienced with a wide range of third-party libraries,
and comfortable collaborating with designers, PMs, and backend developers.

What I enjoy most about development is solving tricky problems
and seeing real feedback from users.
I'm someone who genuinely enjoys the process of exploring and overcoming challenges.

Oh, and yes—I also climb real walls. 🧗‍♂️

carouselSlides.title: 🧗‍♂️ Wall-Climbing Frontend Developer
carouselSlides.subtitle: MinSeob Shim
carouselSlides.content: I live by the motto "You have to smile when times are tough to be first-class." Challenging situations like difficult bugs and complex architecture design don't frustrate me—they draw me into the deep joy of immersion.
carouselSlides.highlight: During my 1+ years of professional experience, I've built various web and mobile services using tools like React, Next.js, and React Native, finding my greatest sense of achievement in solving business problems through technology.

carouselSlides.title: My Greatest Strength is
carouselSlides.subtitle: 'Connection'
carouselSlides.content: I excel at connecting technology, people, and different languages to create synergy.

features.title: I connect people to people
features.content: I believe in the power of positive communication. I meticulously document and share information so colleagues can clearly understand project progress and adapt easily.

features.title: I connect languages and technology
features.content: My ability to speak both Korean and English at a native level allows me to quickly acquire the latest tech trends and official documentation without translation, lowering technical barriers for my team.

carouselSlides.title: Beyond Code
carouselSlides.subtitle: I Solve Real-World Problems
carouselSlides.content: I gain inspiration and energy for development through activities that provide a sense of achievement in daily life.
carouselSlides.highlight: Unlike software development which requires long-term focus, climbing and escape rooms allow me to concentrate fully in a short time to solve immediate problems and taste the immediate joy of success.
carouselSlides.closing: And sometimes, I set aside all logic and take the most simple and comfortable rest with my two adorable cats.

carouselSlides.title: Recent Activities
carouselSlides.subtitle: Continuous Growth and Challenges
carouselSlides.content: I'm steadily growing as a developer by learning new technologies and capabilities.

sections.title: XCoreSystem (2024.08 ~ 2024.10)
sections.content: Developed an internal business app based on RN and Expo to streamline HACCP certification procedures.

detail.content: Implemented over 40 core screens within 2 months, contributing to a 50% reduction in data input time compared to the existing manual process.
Designed hierarchical nested modal structures to reduce user input errors and prevent task abandonment, intuitively improving complex data input workflows.

Prevented unnecessary bugs and rework in early development stages by pre-testing responses from 60+ APIs using Postman and sharing results with colleagues to establish a foundation for stable data integration.

sections.title: Finter (2024.06 ~ 2024.08)
sections.content: Developed a Next.js-based stock community web page.

detail.content: Reduced initial loading time by 1.2 seconds by applying parallel routing and Suspense.
Resolved frequent merge conflicts (100+ per month) that were reducing development productivity by introducing and propagating Git-flow branch strategy to ensure code management stability.
Introduced GraphQL and Relay to separate client and server states, applying caching strategies to minimize unnecessary server requests and ensure data consistency.

sections.title: Pikble (2024.02 ~ 2024.05)
sections.content: Developed an application that provides 3D models using AI technology based on user's shooting data, built with RN and Expo.

detail.content: Implemented 4 major social login features to lower barriers for new user registration and successfully launched the app by handling the app review process.
Implemented React-Three-Fiber based viewer for the core service feature of 3D model visualization, enabling users to view models in various formats.
Documented 'App Store Review Response Guide' based on insights gained from 10 app review and re-review processes, establishing a foundation to shorten review periods for similar future projects.
Improved core issues that hindered user experience by preventing unintended app termination (BackHandler) and reducing abandonment rates during data loading (LoadingIndicator).

sections.title: CandyPay (2023.08 ~ 2024.02)
sections.content: Developed a financial application that enables multiple users to split payments within a single app.

detail.content: Led UI/UX development of core payment features including QR scanning and split payments to enhance user payment convenience.

Implemented core service logic including user tier-based differential permission granting and payment limit settings based on personal income information, establishing a foundation for stable and systematic service operation.
Integrated Cookun API to implement core financial logic that calculates and recommends optimal year-end tax card spending amounts based on individual user income.

Aimed for Financial Security Institute security review approval by refactoring data encryption and user information processing logic according to security guidelines and creating related documentation, contributing to review approval.

sections.title: Portfolio Website (2025.05 ~ Present)
sections.content: The website you're currently viewing - a developer portfolio built with Next.js 14 App Router and TypeScript. Beyond simple self-introduction, this project captures technical considerations and solutions for performance optimization, user experience, and development productivity.

detail.content: Achieved search engine optimization by implementing SSR/SSG hybrid rendering, JSON-LD structured data, and multilingual meta tags for enhanced SEO performance.
Built custom carousel, scroll-based background transitions, and CSS keyframes starlight animations using vanilla JavaScript to minimize external library dependencies.
Implemented global state management with Zustand and complete bilingual support (Korean/English) using React i18next to provide an international user experience.
Ensured type safety throughout development with 100% TypeScript adoption and improved code reusability and maintainability through modularized component architecture.
Established an automated CI/CD pipeline using Vercel and GitHub Actions, creating a development workflow with immediate deployment upon code changes.

sections.title: Watery (2025.06 ~ 2025.09)
sections.content: Developed a personal hydration tracking app based on RN and Expo for recording individual water intake.

detail.content: Identified core target user pain points through surveys of approximately 50 people and established the app's core direction of 'simple recording' and 'achievement' based on findings.
Achieved near-native UI response speed by implementing JSI architecture and reduced initial development time by 30%+ through active utilization of Expo's built-in features.

Enhanced UI/UX completeness through close collaboration with designers based on Figma, and transparently shared team progress and collaboratively shaped project direction through weekly scrum and WBS.

sections.title: Portfolio Website: Initial Version (2023.05 ~ 2023.06)
sections.content: First personal portfolio project implemented without external libraries to demonstrate deep understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript(ES6+) fundamentals in web development.

detail.content: Implemented dynamic UI (carousel sliders, form validation, etc.) using only pure JavaScript(ES6+) without frameworks or libraries, building DOM manipulation and event handling skills.
Demonstrated the ability to implement rich visual effects (loading animations, etc.) using only CSS with @keyframes.
Built an automated deployment pipeline through Vercel, applying efficient development workflow from initial projects.

sections.title: L'acier Men's Cosmetics E-commerce (2023.01 ~ 2023.02)
sections.content: Bootcamp main project that established foundations of component-based development and team collaboration by applying React core concepts to real projects.

detail.content: Implemented carousel sliders without libraries for dynamic UI, gaining in-depth understanding of CSS transition and transform properties to create user interactions.

Realized the importance of thoroughly analyzing and utilizing official documentation when using external libraries through solving react-daum-postcode library option issues that behaved differently than intended.
Understood React's core principles of modularization and component-based architecture by separating and managing repeatedly used UI (product cards, buttons, etc.) into reusable components.

skills.title: Technical Skills
skills.subtitle: Technologies and tools I use to bring ideas to life

descriptions.html5: I understand the importance of web accessibility and semantic markup, and have experience structuring markup with semantic tags and alt attributes to enhance user experience and accessibility.
descriptions.css3: Skilled in mobile-first responsive design using media queries and implementing CSS animations to create smooth user interactions, all without relying on external frameworks.
descriptions.javascript: Built a portfolio website using only vanilla JavaScript, applying ES6 features effectively and demonstrating deep understanding of core concepts like DOM manipulation, event handling, and Flexbox layout.
descriptions.react: I have a clear understanding of React's rendering architecture and the rationale behind the introduction of Fiber. I can explain how component-based architecture has evolved and have experience using features like Suspense, Error Boundary, and Context API to enhance UX. I apply useReducer and useContext appropriately to improve code clarity and maintainability, and I quickly adapt to new syntax and updates in recent React versions.
descriptions.reactNative: Experienced in building mobile apps using React Native, including conditional rendering tailored to platform-specific behavior and implementing BottomSheet UI. I've used three.js for WebGL-based 3D rendering in mobile apps and applied performance optimizations using FlatList and useCallback. Also familiar with styling by platform and designing with native elements like StatusBar and SafeAreaView.
descriptions.typescript: I understand how the TypeScript compiler (tsc) works and am skilled in interface-based type design focused on scalability. I use union, tuple, and enum types appropriately to manage complex data structures and actively leverage TypeScript in production projects to improve stability and prevent runtime errors.
descriptions.nextJS: While still improving my proficiency with Next.js, I've applied both SSR and CSR appropriately based on page requirements in real projects. I've used parallel routing with the App Router for flexible page composition, and have experience handling large datasets using Relay in a GraphQL environment. I'm expanding my Next.js skills through continued practical application.
descriptions.zustand: I understand the lightweight state management structure of Zustand and its hook-based store pattern. I've used it to build global state without boilerplate code, allowing quick prototyping and efficient state sharing across components. I maintain strong type safety by combining Zustand with TypeScript.
descriptions.mobx: I understand MobX's observer pattern and have experience building reactive UIs using decorators like @observable, @action, and @computed. I can explain how automatic re-rendering works based on state changes and manage complex component dependencies in a clean and concise way.
descriptions.redux: Familiar with Redux's predictable state flow and structured design, and can clearly explain the data flow from state → action → reducer → store. I've used Redux Toolkit for managing global state and handled async logic using middleware like Redux Thunk.
descriptions.styledComponent: I understand the strengths of styled-components from a Component-Based Design perspective, using it to abstract and reuse styles at the component level. I've chosen styled-components in cases requiring a declarative and structured styling approach, as opposed to utility-first tools like Tailwind CSS. I'm also aware of the readability issues in JSX with certain declaration styles and the recent official maintenance discontinuation, and I'm exploring alternatives and migration strategies.
descriptions.tailwind: Experienced in using Tailwind CSS, including customizing settings via tailwind.config.ts and managing global styles. I'm aware of Tailwind's style overrides and have rebuilt base UI elements (like h1, button) into reusable components. I actively use Tailwind to implement scalable design systems in production.
descriptions.reactQuery: I understand React Query's caching mechanism and query lifecycle. I can manage data identification using queryKey, distinguish between mutation and fetchQuery usage based on context, and use invalidateQueries to refresh data after mutations. I structure UI based on loading, error, and success states to manage server state in an organized way.
descriptions.git: Proficient in using Git CLI for branching, committing, and merging. I clearly understand the difference between Git and GitHub. I manage commit history with rebase options like squash, reword, and drop, and can resolve complex merge conflicts by identifying issues at the commit level. I also understand the concept of base commits and use rebase strategically to maintain clean team history.
descriptions.github: I manage issues and track task progress using GitHub Projects. I've also worked with tools like Fork and Sourcetree. I'm experienced in code reviews and pull request processes, and understand the collaborative workflows within the GitHub ecosystem for smooth team coordination.
descriptions.githubActions: I've built CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and written YAML files to automate build and deployment processes. I've resolved errors by analyzing logs and continue to optimize workflows through ongoing learning and refinement.
descriptions.vercel: Linked GitHub repositories to Vercel for automated deployment, and configured custom domains and redirect rules. I've used Preview URLs to test pre-release versions and actively used environment variables and CI/CD integrations in real-world projects.
descriptions.figma: Skilled in collaborating with designers to understand and implement component-based design systems. I analyze responsive designs and translate them into code. I've suggested improvements after identifying UX inconsistencies in Figma flows, and I use plugins and prototypes to maintain clear communication with designers.
descriptions.notion: Experienced in using Notion for documenting daily scrums, meeting notes, and Git commit/review conventions. I've built database-driven project pages and split structures for better readability. I even manage my personal schedule with Notion due to my high level of familiarity with the tool.
descriptions.jira: I've used Jira's Kanban boards in ticket-based QA processes, managing client feedback and updates efficiently. I clearly understand the distinctions between Epics, Tasks, and Sub-tasks, and can prioritize issues while customizing workflows.
descriptions.slack: Fluent in using Slack as a primary team communication tool, including mentions, thread-based conversations, file sharing, and notifications. I've also used Slack bots (e.g., Daily GeekNews, CI/CD alerts) to reduce repetitive tasks and foster efficient communication in a real-world setting.
